visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black polo shirt sits at a desk facing a laptop. A banner at the top shows a blue and white graphic with two men's portraits and text. The background is a plain off-white wall. The man uses hand gestures while speaking. (2) A black and white line drawing of a person's head in profile appears, showing the front half shaved and a long braid extending from the back. The background behind the illustration is a solid off-white. (3) Vibrant green forest footage with tall evergreen trees and mossy ground is shown. Sunlight filters through the canopy, creating a dappled light effect. (4) A close-up shot features a small straw doll held by a hand. Smoke from an incense burner or small fire rises in the background, which is dark and out of focus. (5) Archival-style footage shows a crowd of people in an outdoor urban setting during a protest. One woman in the foreground holds a red sign, and another person holds a white sign that says 'SILENT VIOLENCE'. (6) A physical map of East Asia is shown on a table. A hand places a small yellow pin with a Japanese flag onto the island of Taiwan. The lighting is bright and direct. (7) A high-definition close-up shot shows a barber using silver electric clippers to trim the hair on the back of a person's head. The hair is light brown or blonde. (8) A silhouette of a person with very long braided hair is seen against a bright red background. The person is performing a fluid, dance-like movement. (9) The camera returns to the man in the black polo shirt at his desk. He continues to speak and gesture towards the camera. The setting remains the same as in the first phase.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 東亞史探索課. [Slogan]: 升5-9年級專用! 不只中國史的跨文化視野. [Subtitle]: 為什麼清朝男人都要留這麼長的辮子. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是滿洲男性獨特的髮型，前面剃光，只有在後腦勺留一撮辮子. (3) [Subtitle]: 這個髮型跟滿洲人祖先的生活環境有關. (4) [Subtitle]: 在森林裡面騎馬、狩獵、射箭. (5) [Subtitle]: 如果留傳統的長髮，就很容易被樹枝勾到，很不方便. (6) [Subtitle]: 光光的工作上比較方便. (7) [Subtitle]: 也有一說跟他們的宗教信仰有關. (8) [Subtitle]: 滿洲人信仰的薩滿教認為頭頂是靈魂棲息的地方. (9) [Subtitle]: 不可以有頭髮擋住，算是對於祖先的一種尊敬. (10) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼漢人也要留這個辮子. (11) [Subtitle]: 就是因為滿洲人建立了清朝. (12) [Subtitle]: 第一個可能是要區分，到底是服從還是反抗. (13) [Subtitle]: 乖乖的剃髮，表示臣服. (14) [Subtitle]: 另外可能滿洲人也知道自己是少數，擔心漢人的強勢文化會把他們消滅掉. (15) [Subtitle]: 透過強制的剃髮，算是對自己文化的一種保障. (16) [Subtitle]: 當然漢人一定會反彈的啦，就有很多的反抗事件. (17) [Subtitle]: 但都被滿洲軍隊給鎮壓掉了. (18) [Subtitle]: 咦那臺灣勒？為什麼大家都沒有在留辮子啊. (19) [Subtitle]: 因為後來政權又改換，1895年臺灣被日本統治. (20) [Subtitle]: 不過日本政府一開始，也沒有強硬的要求大家剪辮. (21) [Subtitle]: 一直到1911年中國發生了辛亥革命. (22) [Subtitle]: 所以滿洲人被趕走了，在中國也開始流行把辮子給剪掉. (23) [Subtitle]: 這個時候日本政府在臺灣，也趁這個機會，開始強硬的要求把辮子剪掉. (24) [Subtitle]: 剪辮的風潮，在1910年代開始流行. (25) [Subtitle]: 不只是漢人普遍剪掉，其實你到今天，滿洲人自己也沒有在留辮子. (26) [Subtitle]: 現代化已經這麼的普遍. (27) [Subtitle]: 現階段的辮子，剩下民俗表演或是古裝劇你才看得到. (28) [Subtitle]: 留言「東亞史」，告訴你更多相關資訊喔.
